comment: DB-02 (NEC-78) C-10: what a client sends as a procedure argument (arg, Postgres text input form) and what every row-returning read hands back (row). Shared by gossip/ddb/db02_conformance_pg_test.go (written and read through the real node path) and nec-node-sdk tests/ddb-types.test.ts (the SDK's encoders and decoders). bytea goes in as Postgres hex text and comes out as 0x-hex (NEC-164); numeric goes in and out as its exact decimal text.
